payload.description:
Leftover included coding-agent quota is spare capacity. Interactive work is on-demand. Interruptible Kanbus chores (spot tasks) fill leftover before reset and preempt when a human needs the pool.

Two jobs: (1) curated leftover probes for products Anthus uses, (2) dispatch policy including per-product clocks and the assumption that one agentic run may burn a whole remaining window.

Not Fast. Not on-demand spend. Not always-be-agenting. Not a second queue beside Kanbus.
